args.head: fix/fastjson-CVE-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/fastjson-CVE-2026-31337`.

## Notes

- No API changes; dependency-only bump.

2. **Created branch**: `fix/fastjson-CVE-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded**: Bumped `fastjson` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt` (commit `c8b8ab7878`).

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI run `ci-0001` on the branch — it **passed**.

5. **Opened PR**: Created PR #101 against `main` with review requested from **alex**, including a summary of the CVE and the passing CI run.

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review (per policy, merging into main requires code-owner approval).
